aboutGame.title: What is Vaultbreakers?
paragraphs: Vaultbreakers is a co-op extraction RPG from BetaDwarf where squads drop into a dynamic fantasy world, fight through PvE and PvPvE vaults, and race to extract with artifacts, gems, and gear. Every run is a risk-and-reward decision: the longer you stay, the more you can carry out, and the more likely another squad takes it from you.

Progression lives between runs. You pick a breaker, build around a role, socket hardened gems, and upgrade your loadout from the stash you actually manage to bank. Our wiki covers classes, builds, extraction tactics, gear, and updates so you can plan the run before you load in.

modules.name: Vaultbreakers Beginner Guide
modules.description: This module provides new player guidance covering core gameplay systems, extraction mechanics, mission preparation, combat basics, and early progression strategies. It helps beginners understand how to survive expeditions and build their Vaultbreaker effectively.

highlights.detail: Prep a loadout you can afford to lose before you ever enter the vault.
Insert quietly and learn the layout instead of sprinting into open ground.
Collect resources and mark threats while your squad stays together.
Fight as a unit or disengage together, and never chase a kill alone.
Weigh loot value against risk before you commit to one more room.
Move as a group to extraction and cover the rear on the way out.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Vaultbreakers.

items.question: What is Vaultbreakers?
items.answer: Vaultbreakers is a co-op extraction RPG from BetaDwarf where squads drop into a fantasy world, fight through PvE and PvPvE vaults, and race to extract with artifacts, gems, and gear.

items.question: When does Vaultbreakers release?
items.answer: No official Vaultbreakers launch date has been confirmed yet. The game has run periodic playtests, so the official Steam page and developer channels are the most reliable places to track a release window.

items.question: Which class should beginners pick in Vaultbreakers?
items.answer: Start with a frontline or sustained-damage build, which are the most forgiving entry points in Vaultbreakers. Pick the class whose weakness you can live with rather than copying a tier list.

items.question: Can you play Vaultbreakers solo?
items.answer: Yes. Vaultbreakers supports solo and squad runs, but solo play rewards different habits: slow down, avoid unnecessary fights, and prioritize extraction over extra loot.

items.question: How do you keep loot in Vaultbreakers?
items.answer: In Vaultbreakers everything counts only once it is in your stash, so treat the exit as the objective from the first minute, leave earlier than feels comfortable, and avoid fights near extraction points.

items.question: Where can I find Vaultbreakers updates?
items.answer: Vaultbreakers patch notes, playtest windows, and announcements are tracked on the official Steam page and community channels, and our updates hub collects them in one place.
